definitions.full: H313. Acher II. אַחֵר proper name, masculine 1Chr 7:12 (identity & meaning quite dubious; Be thinks = אַחֵר adjective another , to avoid naming Dan (compare Gen 46:23 ; Num 26:42 ) on account of the narrative Judges 17f. Öttli identifies with שַׁחֲרַיִם Judges 17f 8:8>).
